mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation (user_id, title, status, plan_version, source_group_conversation_id, source_map_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{planVersion}, #{sourceGroupConversationId}, #{sourceMapId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, status, plan_json AS planJson, plan_version AS planVersion, saved_activity_id AS savedActivityId, source_group_conversation_id AS sourceGroupConversationId, source_map_id AS sourceMapId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, status, plan_json AS planJson, plan_version AS planVersion, saved_activity_id AS savedActivityId, source_group_conversation_id AS sourceGroupConversationId, source_map_id AS sourceMapId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, status, plan_version AS planVersion, saved_activity_id AS savedActivityId, source_group_conversation_id AS sourceGroupConversationId, source_map_id AS sourceMapId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET plan_json = #{planJson}, plan_version = #{planVersion}, status = #{status}, saved_activity_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET status = 'SAVED', saved_activity_id = #{activityId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'SAVED'
UPDATE ai_conversation SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
